kind: Theuth render check — a table parsed back out of its own html

reconciliation_rule.disclosure: the classes were written after B saw the first residual (1e-6 at k=25); a seat whose tolerance is set after the number is a seat that cannot veto its own owner, so the threshold is offered to the room to freeze before the next table, not claimed as pre-registered

note: worst==0 means every printed cell equals the file at 6 dp. The fourth line is the size of the Letter 025 incident: had these values come from a 4-dp print, the table would sit up to 4.9e-05 nats away from its own artifact and look fine doing it.
